long_biography.plain_text:
Arctic LNG operations gave George Prokopiou's shipping group a technically distinctive role. Dynagas became the first operator to carry LNG through the Northern Sea Route, pairing ice-class ships with gas transportation in frozen waters. The project extended a fleet strategy built around specialised vessels and long-term charter employment.

Acquiring the Skaramangas shipyard moved Prokopiou into repair and construction infrastructure as part of its planned reopening. A civil-engineering graduate, he has chaired the Greek committee of Bureau Veritas and the North of England P&I Association. Those posts place him within the technical-standard and risk institutions used by commercial fleets.
